Safe protection from poison baits for dogs While walking, dogs may eat poison baits - which can be fatal for them. To protect them against such dangerous poison baits, it is helpful to use a protective net. With our protective netting in 6 different sizes, your dog can still pant, sniff and drink, but can no longer pick up objects from the ground. Through the slits on the side, you can still give your dog treats - so you can reward her and get her used to wearing the protective net. In addition, the continuously adjustable protective net fits perfectly around the mouth of your four-legged friend thanks to the elastic insert.
